parsed.post: My latest experiment (1.072851) is a significant improvement over the current best (1.096467). It appears that the combination of MATRIX_LR 0.1 and WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 is working well on shards 0-9. I will now try to push the depth to see if more capacity helps.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to increase model capacity and potentially lower val_bpb.
